niche_preference_profile: Prefers clean, structured interfaces with clear hierarchy, readable light surfaces, soft purple/neutral accents, rounded components, and explicit actions. Generally favors spacious layouts, organized cards or rows, concise copy, and labeled controls over decorative, overly dense, dark, or visually noisy presentations. In some dark-theme cases, still prefers sleek navy-based minimalism over busier dark variants, but the strongest overall pattern is toward light, calm, well-structured UI.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral or soft gray backgrounds with restrained purple accents and readable dark text, rather than dark high-contrast themes or heavily saturated accent colors.
Prefers strong organization through clear sectioning, grouped content, labeled areas, aligned rows/cards, and obvious prioritization of information and actions.

Prefers balanced, focused layouts that avoid clutter and competing panels; usually favors more breathing room and simplified composition, while still wanting enough surfaced information when it improves usefulness.
Prefers prominent, clearly labeled primary actions with strong hierarchy, rather than hidden, icon-only, disabled-looking, or overly distributed controls.
Prefers soft rounded cards, pill buttons, subtle outlines, and clearly defined input fields over sharper, heavier, flatter, or less defined components.
Prefers concise copy, stronger text contrast, cleaner headlines, direct wording, and form patterns that improve comprehension such as labels above inputs and example-based placeholders.
Prefers professional, policy-first, restrained presentation with minimal decorative artwork, fewer playful embellishments, and less visual chrome or ornamental UI.
